recentItems.title: TRUMP VS ILHAN OMAR LIVE: Trump Calls for Deportation of Minnesota Congresswoman Ilhan | World News
recentItems.description:
TRUMP VS ILHAN OMAR LIVE: Trump Calls for Deportation of Minnesota Congresswoman Ilhan | World News

World News: TRUMP VS ILHAN OMAR LIVE | Trump Calls for Deportation of Minnesota Congresswoman Ilhan Omar 
 WASHINGTON — U.S. President Donald Trump has escalated his political and rhetorical feud with Minnesota Representative Ilhan Omar, calling for the naturalized citizen and former Somali refugee to be jailed or deported back to Somalia. Speaking at rallies and via social media, Trump accused Omar of harboring knowledge of large-scale, Somali-led financial fraud schemes in Minnesota, repeating claims that billions of dollars have been pilfered from American taxpayers. Representative Omar has fiercely rejected the allegations, characterizing the president's remarks as racist, xenophobic, and Islamophobic, while asserting that she has no plans to leave the country. The confrontation comes amid a broader federal immigration crackdown in Minnesota known as 'Operation Metro Surge,' which has drawn intense legal and political scrutiny from local leaders and civil rights organizations.
